title: 第115章 不能为我所用，必为我所杀！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 姜云娜破防了。“不可能，我不相信，这是假的，假的……”姜云娜攥紧拳头，在心头怒吼，眼前的唐逸彻底颠覆了她的认知，和他所熟悉的唐逸完全是两个极端。这种感觉就像是一直牵在手中的哈巴狗，忽然变成了斑斓猛虎，那种不受控制的感觉，让她近乎抓狂。在她身侧，颜霜玉此时的脸色那是又青又白又紫。看着台上从容的唐逸，她那一双眼睛都在泛红，几乎都要瞪出血来了。“怎么会这样？这怎么回事？怎么回事？”“不是这样的，不应该是这样的，唐逸他怎么可能翻身？”颜霜玉难以接受这一幕，愤怒到发狂。这些年，她对唐逸的压制，几乎到了变态的地步，竟然都没有抑制住唐逸的成长，让这家伙摇身一变，成了名动京都的小诗仙。现在，更是用两首词，将她们的脸按在地上摩擦。刚才她和姜云娜为了诬陷唐逸，在众人面前贬低和诋毁他，现在唐逸用行动证明了她们刚才的举动，是多么的愚蠢和可笑。脸，直接被打得啪啪响。更让颜霜玉崩溃的是，现在众人看她的目光，俨然就是在看一个上蹿下跳的小丑。这是废物？这是需要买诗词的伪君子？你们是对废物和伪君子有误会吗？“小诗仙就是小诗仙，连站在唐小姐的角度都写得这么肝肠寸断，这还比个毛？”“妈的，我没事上台干嘛？上台接受羞辱吗？”“十年寒窗……呸，太痛苦了，感觉和这家伙一起站在台上，老子十年寒窗白读了。”“……”舞台上，原本愤怒不爽以为唐逸只是运气好的众人，现在看着唐逸目光都复杂而惶恐了。他们很多人，都是受了那些大臣的好处，在舞台上联手对付唐逸，可特妈的现在还怎么黑？没看到人家两首词，直接把一群女人感动得稀里哗啦吗？现在敢质疑，唐逸不出手恐怕这群女人都能将他们给撕了。就连唐画这时候盯着前方端着茶杯，一副事不关己的唐逸，眼神也有些涣散了。这样的诗词，他这辈子都写不出来！该死的，这混蛋明明一直被他压制得死死的，连喜欢的女人都成了他得女人，他怎么还能翻身？而唐敬，此时已经跌坐在位置上，心头就像是星辰落海掀起惊涛浪。哪怕再不愿意承认，他都不得不承认自己看走眼了，这个他最看不上的儿子，的确很厉害。但要说后悔？那是没有的。唐敬目光落在唐画的身上，脸色渐渐坚毅起来，他相信自己亲手培养出来的唐画，肯定不会比唐逸差半点。“原来，你一直在伪装，小小年纪心机如此阴险，也配做我唐敬的儿子？”唐敬双眼渐渐变冷，心中不仅没有半点后悔，反而怒不可遏。这混账选在今日一鸣惊人，和唐画争雄，分明就是罔顾唐家的利益。有点才华又如何？不听话不为唐家荣誉着想，就是唐家的败类罢了。而看着唐阴沉的脸，刘温，赵柯等大臣差点忍不住凑过去，狠狠在他脸上甩几个大巴掌。陛下设计坑我们，你唐敬就是最大的助力，要不是相信你的话，确定唐逸就是个废物，我们现在何至于这么被动。不，这已经不是被动了！这是被完虐啊！我们一群位高权重的大臣，现在被你儿子给虐得连还手的余地都没有，这事过不去了！“唐敬，这就是你说的……唐逸废物？！”刘温睨着身侧的唐敬，忍不住想要拎起屁股下的椅子，往他脑袋上砸过去。“唐侍郎，你最好给我们一个解释。”赵柯也看向刘温，声音冷冽咬牙切齿，心头那是一个憋屈。他早就查出小诗仙就是唐逸，但因为唐敬信誓旦旦的保证，他才一次次动摇。却没想到，原来真相从一开始，就已经在他手中大白了。其他一众文臣目光也都落在唐敬的身上，眼神都十分不善。要不是因为皇帝在，他们定要让唐敬知道，他们不仅嘴厉害，偶尔也是可以研究一下拳脚的。“解释？我自己都还想要解释呢。”唐敬脸色铁青，他也想知道怎么回事好吧！“你最好祈祷唐画能写出比唐逸更好的诗词，否则这事没完。”刘温沉声说道，忍耐已经到了极限。儿子被唐逸整得死活不知，这仇大了。今日要是不能灭了唐逸报仇，那他和唐敬就是死仇！“放心，我对画儿……很有信心。”唐敬目光落在台上的唐画身上，他对这个儿子很有信心，笃信唐画能胜过唐逸。唐画可是他亲自培养出来的，三元及第的状元！但不知道的是……他寄予厚望的大儿子，现在心态已经爆炸了啊！当然，此时心态更爆炸的，还有一个人。太子萧琮！看在台上自信从容的唐逸，太子脸色阴沉而狰狞。“这怎么可能？洪竹，不是说他是废物吗？他为什么不是废物？”太子额上青筋直跳，愤怒得整张脸都红了，他早就给唐逸做好了垃圾分类，垃圾就该待在垃圾堆里。结果，现在唐逸却用行动向所有人证明，他不是什么垃圾，而是闪闪发光的一座金山。此时此刻，想到炎文帝对唐逸的评价，萧琮心底就莫名发慌。炎文帝说了，收服唐逸，可以稳定他得太子之位。反之，和唐逸为敌，他的太子之位不稳。原本以为炎文帝言过其实，但现在看来，恐怕还真有这个可能。“殿下，奴婢查到的信息是他就是废物啊……”洪竹跪在太子面前，也是脸色煞白，不知道哪里出现了问题。之前调查唐画的资料的时候，他的确也顺便连唐逸的资料也查过了，那时的资料显示，唐逸是唐家公仆，就是个没用的废物。谁能想到，他现在一跃成了京都炙手可热的小诗仙，还得到了陛下的重视。“不论如何，唐逸绝对不能和燕王勾搭在一起。”太子盯着台上的唐逸，脸上有了狠戾：“沈园诗会后，替孤约一下唐逸，看下能不能将他重新拉拢过来。”“若不为我所用，必被我所杀！”而炎文帝看着这一幕，差点又跳了起来。哈哈，稳了，胜局已定！
content_en: Jiang Yunna broke her defense."Impossible, I don't believe it, this is fake, fake..." Jiang Yunna clenched her fists and roared in her heart. The Tang Yi in front of her completely subverted her understanding. It was completely different from the Tang Yi she was familiar with.This feeling was like a pug that had been in her hand suddenly turned into a colorful tiger. The feeling of being out of control made her almost crazy.Beside her, Yan Shuangyu's face was green, white and purple at this time.Looking at Tang Yi who was calm on the stage, her eyes were red and almost bleeding."How could this happen? What's going on? What's going on?" "It's not like this. It shouldn't be like this. How could Tang Yi turn over?" Yan Shuangyu couldn't accept this scene and was so angry that she went crazy.Over the years, her suppression of Tang Yi was almost to the point of perversion, but she did not even inhibit Tang Yi's growth, allowing this guy to transform into a famous poetry fairy in Kyoto.Now, he used two words to rub their faces on the ground.Just now, in order to frame Tang Yi, she and Jiang Yunna belittled and slandered him in front of everyone. Now Tang Yi has proved with actions how stupid and ridiculous their actions just now were.His face was slapped directly.What made Yan Shuangyu even more devastated was that now everyone was looking at her as if they were looking at a clown jumping up and down.Is this trash?Is this a hypocrite who needs to buy poetry?Do you have a misunderstanding about trash and hypocrites?"The Little Poet Fairy is the Little Poet Fairy. Even from Miss Tang's point of view, she writes so heartbroken. Isn't that a big deal?" "Damn it, why should I go on stage? Do you want to go on stage and accept the humiliation?" "Ten Years of Cold Windows... Bah, it's too painful. I feel like standing on the stage with this guy. I have read in vain." "..." On the stage, everyone who was originally angry and unhappy and thought Tang Yi was just lucky, now looked at Tang Yi with complex and frightened eyes.Many of them had benefited from those ministers and joined forces to deal with Tang Yi on the stage, but how could they still be so evil now?Didn't you see that two of his poems directly moved a group of women into fits of laughter?If I dare to question it now, if Tang Yi doesn't take action, I'm afraid these women will tear them apart.Even Tang Hua was staring ahead at Tang Yi, who was holding a tea cup, as if it had nothing to do with him, and his eyes were a little distracted.He would never be able to write such a poem in his life!Damn it, this bastard has been suppressed by him for a long time. Even the woman he likes has become his woman. How can he turn around?Tang Jing, on the other hand, had fallen into his seat at this time, and his heart felt like a star falling into the sea and causing a stormy wave.No matter how reluctant he was to admit it, he had to admit that he had made a mistake. The son he despised the most was indeed very powerful.But to say regret?That's not the case.Tang Jing's eyes fell on Tang Hua, and his face gradually became resolute. He believed that Tang Hua, whom he personally cultivated, would definitely not be any worse than Tang Yi."It turns out that you have been pretending, and you are so scheming at a young age. Are you worthy of being my Tang Jing's son?" Tang Jing's eyes gradually turned cold, and not only did he not have any regrets in his heart, but he was furious.This bastard chose to become a blockbuster today and compete with Tang Hua for supremacy. He clearly ignored the interests of the Tang family.So what if you have some talent?Those who are disobedient and do not care about the honor of the Tang family are just the scum of the Tang family.Looking at Tang's gloomy face, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers almost couldn't help but approach him and slap him hard on the face.Your Majesty designed to trick us, and you, Tang Jing, were the biggest help. If I hadn't believed in you, Tang Yi would have been a waste. Why would we be so passive now?No, this is no longer passive!This is complete abuse!We, a group of high-ranking ministers, are now being abused by your son to the point where they have no room to fight back. This matter cannot be tolerated!"Tang Jing, is this what you said...Tang Yi is useless?!" Liu Wen stared at Tang Jing beside him and couldn't help but want to pick up the chair under his butt and throw it on his head."Shilang Tang, you'd better give us an explanation." Zhao Ke also looked at Liu Wen, his voice was cold and he gritted his teeth, feeling aggrieved in his heart.He had long since found out that Xiao Shixian was Tang Yi, but because of Tang Jing's solemn assurance, he was wavered again and again.But he didn't expect that the truth had been revealed in his hands from the beginning.The eyes of other civil servants also fell on Tang Jing, and their eyes were very unkind.If it weren't for the emperor's presence, they would have let Tang Jing know that not only were they good at talking, but they could also practice fisting occasionally."Explanation? I still want to explain myself." Tang Jing's face turned pale. He also wanted to know what was going on!"You'd better pray that Tang Hua can write better poems than Tang Yi, otherwise this matter will never be over." Liu Wen said in a deep voice, his patience reaching its limit.His son was being manipulated by Tang Yi to the point where he didn't know whether he was alive or dead. This was a big hatred.If he couldn't kill Tang Yi and take revenge today, then he and Tang Jing would be mortal enemies!"Don't worry, I'm... very confident in Hua'er." Tang Jing's eyes fell on Tang Hua on the stage. He was very confident in his son and firmly believed that Tang Hua could beat Tang Yi.Tang Hua was trained by him personally, and he was the number one scholar in three yuan!But what I don't know is... his eldest son, who had high hopes for him, is now mentally exploded!Of course, there is another person who is even more explosive at this time.Prince Xiao Cong!Seeing Tang Yi, who was confident and calm on the stage, the prince's face turned gloomy and ferocious."How is this possible? Hong Zhu, didn't you say he is a waste? Why is he not a waste?" The veins on the prince's forehead jumped, and his whole face turned red with anger. He had already sorted the garbage for Tang Yi, and the garbage should stay in the garbage heap.As a result, Tang Yi has now used his actions to prove to everyone that he is not trash, but a shining golden mountain.At this moment, Xiao Cong felt inexplicably panicked when he thought of Emperor Yanwen's evaluation of Tang Yi.Emperor Yanwen said that conquering Tang Yi would stabilize his position as prince.On the contrary, if he becomes an enemy of Tang Yi, his position as prince will be unstable.I originally thought that Emperor Yanwen was exaggerating, but now it seems that this is really possible."Your Highness, the information I found out is that he is a waste..." Hong Zhu knelt in front of the prince, his face turned pale, and he didn't know what went wrong.When he was investigating Tang Hua's information before, he did also check Tang Yi's information.
